name: Stability AI
h1: Stability AI ARR: ~$90M, Rebuilt After the 2024 Crisis.
intro: Stability AI's revenue has never been cleanly disclosed. Third-party estimates (Sacra, Presenc AI) put it near $90M annualized in 2026 — a fraction of its former $4B peak valuation, which repriced to ~$300M in a down round. The timeline below is assembled from estimates and press reporting.

modelTitle: How Free Models Became Paid API Credits.
modelParagraphs: Stability monetizes the models it once gave away. Usage-based API credits for Stable Diffusion and the image, video, audio and 3D model families are now the primary revenue driver; membership and developer subscription plans — self-hosting licenses for commercial use — account for over 70% of revenue, with tiers historically starting near $20/month for creators and custom pricing for licensed self-hosting.

On top sits 'Stability AI Solutions': custom and private model fine-tuning plus consulting for enterprises scaling creative production, with WPP among the named strategic investors and partners. The pivot from open-source evangelism to metered access is what stabilized the business — but at a ~$300M valuation, the market is pricing it as a niche infrastructure play, not the category leader its open models created.

faqs.q: What Is Stability AI's ARR in 2026?
faqs.a: Not officially disclosed. Third-party estimates (Presenc AI, Sacra) put annualized revenue around $90 million in 2026, up from roughly $50M estimated for 2024 — with growth above 65% into 2025.

faqs.q: How Much Revenue Did Stability AI Make at Peak Hype?
faqs.a: Surprisingly little: an estimated ~$1.5M in 2022 and ~$8M in 2023, despite Stable Diffusion powering billions of images. Monetization lagged the open-source distribution by years.

faqs.q: What Happened to Stability AI's Valuation?
faqs.a: It collapsed from a ~$4B peak to a reported ~$300M down round, after founder Emad Mostaque's March 2024 exit and reporting on unpaid bills. The company survived by pivoting to paid API access, licenses and enterprise work under new leadership, with WPP investing and James Cameron joining the board.

faqs.q: What Does Stability AI Actually Sell?
faqs.a: Usage-based API credits, membership and self-hosting commercial licenses (over 70% of revenue combined), and 'Stability AI Solutions' — custom model training and consulting for enterprise creative production.

faqs.q: How Reliable Are These Revenue Estimates?
faqs.a: Low confidence — Stability has never published audited revenue. All figures on this page are third-party estimates triangulated from investor reports and press, and should be treated as directional.
